description: UnTelevised correspondent Salah Akram reports from Khan Younis as Israeli bombardment escalates across Gaza — naming the dead, bearing witness, and asking the world to look.

faqs.answer: Salah Akram is an UnTelevised Media correspondent reporting from inside Gaza. He is a software engineering student and author of "Between Life and Death in Gaza." His reporting provides first-hand, real-time testimony from the ground.
faqs.question: Who is Salah Akram?

faqs.answer: This dispatch was reported from the Khan Younis area in southern Gaza during a period of escalated Israeli bombardment across the Strip on May 17, 2026.
faqs.question: Where was this article reported from?

faqs.answer: Five Palestinians killed on May 17, 2026: Ahmed Salem Abu Asad, Abdul Rahman Ahmed Muhammad Muhaysin, Ibrahim Rayyan, Abdullah Ahmed Abu Mustafa, and Muhammad Akram Mohsen Al-Shaer.
